        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      const isFile = s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.url &amp;&amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;&amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\n      if (isFile) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] 识别为文件:', { id: s.id, title: s.title, url: s.url });\n      }\n      return isFile;\n    });\n    \n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\n      if (s.url &amp;&amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;&amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\n        return false;\n      }\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\n      return true;\n    });\n    \n    console.log('[资源清单] 更新配置资源:', {\n      文件数量: files.length,\n      互联网信息数量: internetInfo.length,\n      技术点数量: techPoints.filter(tp =&gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)).length,\n      知识点数量: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id)).length\n    });\n    \n    setConfiguredResources({\n      files: files,\n\n  }\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    \n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'user');\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\n    \n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\n    try {\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\n        try {\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\n            await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\n      \n      if (savedId) {\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\n        \n        // 刷新历史记录\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\n        await checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查并更新历史记录视图\n        \n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    setConfiguredResources({\n      files: files,\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\n      knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id))\n    });\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\n\n  const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        }\n      });\n      console.log('[加载来源] API响应:', response.data);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const loadedSources = response.data.data;\n        console.log('[加载来源] 加载的来源数量:', loadedSources.length);\n        console.log('[加载来源] 来源列表:', loadedSources.map((s: SourceInformation) =&gt; ({\n          id: s.id,\n          title: s.title,\n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          page_type: (s as any).page_type\n        })));\n        setSources(loadedSources);\n      } else {\n        console.warn('[加载来源] API返回失败或没有数据:', response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[加载来源] 加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 提炼为技术点\n  const handleExtractTechPoint = async (record: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n    setExtractingTechPoint(true);\n    setExtractingSourceId(record.id);\n    \n    try {\n      // 获取对话内容\n      const conversationContent = record.description || record.title || '';\n      \n      // 构建AI提示词，要求提取技术点信息并转换为JSON格式\n      const extractPrompt = &#96;你是一个技术信息提取专家。请分析以下对话内容，提炼关键信息并转换为技术点的标准JSON格式。\n\n对话内容：\n${conversationContent}\n\n请提取以下关键信息并生成JSON：\n\n必需字段：\n1. name: 技术名称（简短、准确，不超过50字）\n2. description: 技术描述（1-2句话概括，不超过200字）\n3. tech_type: 技术类型（必须是：feature、improvement、innovation、technology 之一）\n4. priority: 优先级（必须是：low、medium、high 之一）\n5. technical_details: 技术细节（JSON对象，可以包含：tech_principle技术原理、tech_value技术价值、tech_boundary技术边界等）\n6. benefits: 技术优势（字符串数组，列出3-5个关键优势，每个不超过100字）\n7. applications: 应用场景（字符串数组，列出应用场景，每个不超过100字）\n8. keywords: 关键词（字符串数组，提取3-8个关键词）\n9. features: 特性说明（字符串，格式化的markdown，包含：\n   - 【一句话说明（slogan）】\n   - 【技术品牌定位与愿景】\n   - 【用户体验与场景】\n   如果信息不足，可以使用\"敬请期待\"作为占位符）\n\n输出要求：\n- 只返回JSON格式，不要包含任何markdown代码块标记或其他文字说明\n- JSON必须是有效的，可以直接用JSON.parse()解析\n- 如果某些信息无法从对话中提取，使用合理的默认值或空值\n- 所有数组字段必须是数组格式，即使为空也要使用[]\n- technical_details必须是对象格式，即使为空也要使用{}\n\n示例JSON格式：\n{\n  \"name\": \"技术名称\",\n  \"description\": \"技术描述\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"feature\",\n  \"priority\": \"medium\",\n  \"technical_details\": {\n    \"tech_principle\": \"技术原理说明\",\n    \"tech_value\": \"技术价值说明\",\n    \"tech_boundary\": \"技术边界说明\"\n  },\n  \"benefits\": [\"优势1\", \"优势2\", \"优势3\"],\n  \"applications\": [\"场景1\", \"场景2\"],\n  \"keywords\": [\"关键词1\", \"关键词2\", \"关键词3\"],\n  \"features\": \"【一句话说明（slogan）】\\\\n说明内容\\\\n【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\\\n定位：定位说明\\\\n愿景：愿景说明\\\\n【用户体验与场景】\\\\n场景说明\"\n}\n\n现在请分析对话内容并返回JSON：&#96;;\n;\n;",

    {

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \n\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n      try {\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\n        const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\n标题：[标题]\n摘要：[摘要内容]\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n          summaryPrompt,\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n          undefined\n        );\n\n        if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\s*(.+)/);\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\s*(.+?)(?:\\n|$)/s);\n          \n          if (titleMatch &amp;&amp; titleMatch[1]) {\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\n          }\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;&amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\n            if (summaryDescription.length &lt; 200) {\n              summaryDescription = &#96;${summaryDescription}\\n\\n完整对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &gt; 0 \n          ? &#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&#96;\n          : '项目对话摘要';\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载历史记录（用于模态框）\n  const loadHistoryRecords = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    setHistoryLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 1000\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\n          let category: string | undefined;\n          if (source.metadata) {\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\n              try {\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\n              } catch (e) {\n                // 忽略解析错误\n              }\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\n            }\n          }\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\n          if (source.category) {\n            category = source.category;\n          }\n          return category &amp;&amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\n        });\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载历史记录失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setHistoryLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取来源的类别\n  const getSourceCategory = (source: SourceInformation)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "# 项目资源页面Agent调用分析\n\n## 分析结果\n\n### 1. AI问答功能 ✅ **调用Agent**\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&#96;\n**函数**: &#96;handleAISendMessage()&#96;\n\n**实现方式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 调用AI问答API\nconst result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n  currentMessage,\n  inputs,\n  (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n  aiConversationId || undefined\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**调用链路**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhandleAISendMessage()\n  ↓\nworkflowAPI.aiSearch()\n  ↓\nPOST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search\n  ↓\n后端工作流执行 / Dify调用\n  ↓\nAgent执行\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**特点**:\n- ✅ 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\n- ✅ 包含项目资源上下文（技术点、文件、知识点）\n- ✅ 通过工作流API调用，最终会调用Agent\n- ✅ 可以配置Dify配置（smart-workflow-ai-qa）\n\n**结论**: **是调用Agent的**\n\n---\n\n### 2. 技术转译功能 ❌ **不调用Agent**\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&#96;\n**函数**: &#96;handleTechnicalTranslation()&#96;\n\n**实现方式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nconst handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&gt; {\n  // 只是简单地拼接项目资源为markdown格式\n  const contentParts: string[] = [];\n  \n  // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\n  // 2. 拼接已上传的文件\n  // 3. 拼接已选择的知识点\n  // 4. 拼接互联网信息点\n  \n  const finalContent = contentParts.join('');\n  setTranslatedContent(finalContent);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**功能说明**:\n- 这是一个**纯前端的数据整理功能**\n- 将项目资源（技术点、文件、知识点、互联网信息）整理成markdown格式\n- **不涉及任何AI调用**\n- 只是将已选择的资源内容格式化输出\n\n**调用链路**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhandleTechnicalTranslation()\n  ↓\n前端数据整理（拼接markdown）\n  ↓\n显示转译结果\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**: **不是调用Agent的**，只是数据整理功能\n\n---\n\n## 总结\n\n| 功能 | 是否调用Agent | 说明 |\n|------|--------------|------|\n| **AI问答** | ✅ 是 | 通过&#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&#96;调用，最终会执行Agent |\n| **技术转译** | ❌ 否 | 纯前端数据整理，将项目资源格式化为markdown |",

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { db } from '@/config/database';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\nimport crypto from 'crypto';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport path from 'path';\\n\\nexport interface FileRecord {\\n  id: number;\\n  file_id: string;\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category: string;\\n  tags?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  usage_count: number;\\n  last_used_at?: string;\\n  status: 'active' | 'archived' | 'deleted';\\n  metadata?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface CreateFileParams {\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category?: string;\\n  tags?: string[];\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n}\\n\\nexport class FileService {\\n  /**\\n   * 初始化文件表\\n   */\\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n          file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\\n          original_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          stored_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_url TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n          file_hash TEXT,\\n          category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',\\n          tags TEXT,\\n          description TEXT,\\n          uploader_id TEXT,\\n          conversation_id TEXT,\\n          usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\n          last_used_at DATETIME,\\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n          metadata TEXT,\\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        );\\n\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      // 执行多个SQL语句\\n      const statements = sql.split(';').filter(s =&amp;gt; s.trim());\\n      for (const statement of statements) {\\n        if (statement.trim()) {\\n          await db.query(statement);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      logger.info('文件表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('文件表初始化失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 计算文件哈希值\\n   */\\n  private async calculateFileHash(filePath: string): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');\\n      const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);\\n\\n      stream.on('data', (data) =&amp;gt; hash.update(data));\\n      stream.on('end', () =&amp;gt; resolve(hash.digest('hex')));\\n      stream.on('error', reject);\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成文件ID\\n   */\\n  private generateFileId(): string {\\n    return &amp;#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15)}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建文件记录\\n   */\\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 计算文件哈希值\\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\\n        \\n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\\n        if (existing) {\\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\\n          return existing;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ? JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ? JSON.stringify(params.metadata) : null;\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        INSERT INTO files (\\n          file_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_url,\\n          mime_type, file_size, file_hash, category, tags, description,\\n          uploader_id, conversation_id, metadata\\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      await db.query(sql, [\\n        fileId,\\n        params.original_name,\\n        params.stored_name,\\n        params.file_path,\\n        params.file_url,\\n        params.mime_type,\\n        params.file_size,\\n        fileHash || null,\\n        params.category || 'general',\\n        tagsJson,\\n        params.description || null,\\n        params.uploader_id || null,\\n        params.conversation_id || null,\\n        metadataJson,\\n      ]);\\n\\n      const file = await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      if (!file) {\\n        throw new Error('创建文件记录失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('文件记录创建成功', { fileId, originalName: params.original_name });\\n      return file;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('创建文件记录失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据文件ID获取文件记录\\n   */\\n  async getFileByFileId(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_id = ? AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件记录失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据哈希值查找文件\\n   */\\n  async findByHash(fileHash: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_hash = ? AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileHash]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('根据哈希查找文件失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 增加文件使用次数\\n   */\\n  async incrementUsageCount(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        UPDATE files \\n        SET usage_count = usage_count + 1,\\n            last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        WHERE file_id = ?\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('增加文件使用次数失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    status?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\n    limit?: number;\\n    offset?: number;\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      let sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&amp;#96;;\\n      const params: any[] = [];\\n\\n      if (options?.category) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND category = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.status) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.status);\\n      } else {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND conversation_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(&amp;#96;%\\\"pageType\\\":\\\"${options.pageType}\\\"%&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\\n\\n      // 排除乱码文件名\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.limit);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.offset);\\n      }\\n\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\\n      \\n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\\n      const fileMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, FileRecord&amp;gt;();\\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\\n        if (row.file_hash) {\\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\\n          if (!existing || new Date(row.created_at) &amp;gt; new Date(existing.created_at)) {\\n            fileMap.set(row.file_hash, row);\\n          }\\n        } else {\\n          // 没有哈希值的文件，使用file_id作为key\\n          fileMap.set(row.file_id, row);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      return Array.from(fileMap.values());\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n      return [];\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新文件信息\\n   */\\n  async updateFile(fileId: string, updates: {\\n    description?: string;\\n    tags?: string[];\\n    category?: string;\\n    metadata?: any;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const setClauses: string[] = [];\\n      const params: any[] = [];\\n\\n      if (updates.description !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('description = ?');\\n        params.push(updates.description);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.tags !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('tags = ?');\\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.tags));\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.category !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('category = ?');\\n        params.push(updates.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.metadata !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('metadata = ?');\\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.metadata));\\n      }\\n\\n      if (setClauses.length === 0) {\\n        return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      }\\n\\n      setClauses.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\\n      params.push(fileId);\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;UPDATE files SET ${setClauses.join(', ')} WHERE file_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, params);\\n\\n      return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('更新文件信息失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除文件（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async deleteFile(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;UPDATE files SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n      return true;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nexport const fileService = new FileService();\\n\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 9205,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 按类别分组历史记录\\n  const groupedHistoryRecords = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const groups: Record&amp;lt;string, SourceInformation[]&amp;gt; = {\\n      'ai-qa-summary': [],\\n      'tech-package-qa': [],\\n      'tech-strategy-qa': [],\\n      'tech-article-qa': [],\\n      'technical-translation': [],\\n      'other': []\\n    };\\n\\n    historyRecords.forEach(record =&amp;gt; {\\n      const category = getSourceCategory(record);\\n      if (category &amp;amp;&amp;amp; groups[category]) {\\n        groups[category].push(record);\\n      } else {\\n        groups['other'].push(record);\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return groups;\\n  };\\n\\n  // 打开历史记录模态框\\n  const handleOpenHistoryModal = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowHistoryModal(true);\\n    loadHistoryRecords();\\n  };\\n\\n  // 切换到AI共创视图\\n  const handleSwitchToAICreation = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowHistoryView(false);\\n  };\\n\\n  // 切换到历史记录视图\\n  const handleSwitchToHistory = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowHistoryView(true);\\n    loadHistoryRecords();\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadTechPoints = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints({\\n        page: 1,\\n        pageSize: 100\\n      });\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载技术点失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadKnowledgePoints = async (techPointIds: number[]) =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Upload, Search, X, FileText, Trash2, Check, ChevronDown, FileCode, Eye, Save, Send, Loader2, User, Bot, Brain, History, MessageSquare, Package, Target, Newspaper } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\\nimport { publicKnowledgeService } from '../services/publicKnowledgeService';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { KnowledgePoint } from '../types/knowledgePoint';\\nimport { FileUploadResponse } from '../types/aiSearch';\\nimport { PublicKnowledgeFile } from '../types/publicKnowledge';\\nimport api from '../services/api';\\nimport { workflowAPI } from '../services/api';\\nimport { configService } from '../services/configService';\\nimport sourceService, { Source, SourceCategory } from '../services/sourceService';\\n\\ninterface SourceInformation {\\n  id: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n  category?: SourceCategory;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [sources, setSources] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\\n  const [selectedTechPoints, setSelectedTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedKnowledgePoints, setSelectedKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [knowledgePoints, setKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;KnowledgePoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [publicKnowledgeFiles, setPublicKnowledgeFiles] = useState&amp;lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedPublicFiles, setSelectedPublicFiles] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointSelector, setShowTechPointSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgeBaseSelector, setShowKnowledgeBaseSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [techPointSearch, setTechPointSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [knowledgeBaseSearch, setKnowledgeBaseSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [publicFileSearch, setPublicFileSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [configuredResources, setConfiguredResources] = useState&amp;lt;{\\n    files: SourceInformation[];\\n    internetInfo: SourceInformation[];\\n    techPoints: TechPoint[];\\n    knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[];\\n  }&amp;gt;({\\n    files: [],\\n    internetInfo: [],\\n    techPoints: [],\\n    knowledgePoints: []\\n  });\\n  const [isTranslating, setIsTranslating] = useState(false);\\n  const [translatedContent, setTranslatedContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [showReviewModal, setShowReviewModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [reviewContent, setReviewContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointModal, setShowTechPointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showFileUploadModal, setShowFileUploadModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgePointModal, setShowKnowledgePointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showInternetInfoModal, setShowInternetInfoModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [isSummarizingConversation, setIsSummarizingConversation] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryModal, setShowHistoryModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [historyRecords, setHistoryRecords] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryView, setShowHistoryView] = useState(false); // 控制显示历史记录视图还是AI共创视图\\n  const [checkingHistory, setCheckingHistory] = useState(true); // 检查历史记录中\\n  const fileInputRefModal = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  // AI问答相关状态\\n  const [aiMessages, setAiMessages] = useState&amp;lt;Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [aiInputMessage, setAiInputMessage] = useState('');\\n  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [aiConversationId, setAiConversationId] = useState&amp;lt;string | undefined&amp;gt;(undefined);\\n  const aiMessagesEndRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (projectId) {\\n      loadProject();\\n      loadSources();\\n      loadTechPoints();\\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\\n      checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查历史记录\\n    }\\n  }, [projectId]);\\n\\n  // AI消息自动滚动到底部\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    aiMessagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\\n  }, [aiMessages]);\\n\\n  // AI问答发送消息\\n  const handleAISendMessage = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!aiInputMessage.trim() || aiLoading) return;\\n\\n    const userMessage = {\\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\\n      content: aiInputMessage.trim(),\\n      sender: 'user' as const,\\n      timestamp: new Date(),\\n    };\\n\\n    setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\\n    const currentMessage = aiInputMessage.trim();\\n    setAiInputMessage('');\\n    setAiLoading(true);\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 获取智能工作流AI问答的Dify配置\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n\\n      // 构建上下文信息（包含项目资源）\\n      const contextMessages = aiMessages.map((msg) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        role: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',\\n        content: msg.content,\\n      }));\\n\\n      // 添加项目资源信息到上下文\\n      const resourceContext: string[] = [];\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的技术点：${configuredResources.techPoints.map(tp =&amp;gt; tp.name).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已上传的文件：${configuredResources.files.map(f =&amp;gt; f.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的知识点：${configuredResources.knowledgePoints.map(kp =&amp;gt; kp.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      const inputs: any = {\\n        context: contextMessages,\\n      };\\n\\n      if (resourceContext.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\n');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        currentMessage,\\n        inputs,\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        responseContent = result.data.answer || result.data.result || responseContent;\\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\\n        if (result.data.conversation_id) {\\n          setAiConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        responseContent = result.error || responseContent;\\n      }\\n\\n      const aiMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: responseContent,\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\n      const errorMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\\n    } finally {\\n      setAiLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\"检索信息\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\n    });\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    setConfiguredResources({\\n      files: files,\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\\n      knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id))\\n    });\\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\\n\\n  const loadProject = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setProject(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        setSources(response.data.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    setCheckingHistory(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 1000\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\\n          let category: string | undefined;\\n          if (source.metadata) {\\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\n              try {\\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\n              } catch (e) {\\n                // 忽略解析错误\\n              }\\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\n            }\\n          }\\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\\n          if (source.category) {\\n            category = source.category;\\n          }\\n          return category &amp;amp;&amp;amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\\n        });\\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\\n        // 如果有历史记录，显示历史记录视图；否则显示AI共创视图\\n        setShowHistoryView(filtered.length &amp;gt; 0);\\n      } else {\\n        setShowHistoryView(false);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('检查历史记录失败:', error);\\n      setShowHistoryView(false);\\n    } finally {\\n      setCheckingHistory(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 加载历史记录（用于模态框）\\n  const loadHistoryRecords = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    setHistoryLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 1000\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\\n          let category: string | undefined;\\n          if (source.metadata) {\\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\n              try {\\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\n              } catch (e) {\\n                // 忽略解析错误\\n              }\\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\n            }\\n          }\\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\\n          if (source.category) {\\n            category = source.category;\\n          }\\n          return category &amp;amp;&amp;amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\\n        });\\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载历史记录失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setHistoryLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 获取来源的类别\\n  const getSourceCategory = (source: SourceInformation): SourceCategory | undefined =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (source.category) {\\n      return source.category;\\n    }\\n    if (source.metadata) {\\n      if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\n          return parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\n        } catch (e) {\\n          return undefined;\\n        }\\n      } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\n        return source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\n      }\\n    }\\n    return undefined;\\n  };\\n\\n  // 获取类别显示名称\\n  const getCategoryDisplayName = (category?: SourceCategory): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (category) {\\n      case 'ai-qa-summary':\\n        return 'AI问答';\\n      case 'tech-package-qa':\\n        return '技术包装';\\n      case 'tech-strategy-qa':\\n        return '技术策略';\\n      case 'tech-article-qa':\\n        return '技术通稿';\\n      case 'technical-translation':\\n        return '技术转译';\\n      default:\\n        return '其他';\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 获取类别图标\\n  const getCategoryIcon = (category?: SourceCategory) =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (category) {\\n      case 'ai-qa-summary':\\n        return &amp;lt;MessageSquare className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n      case 'tech-package-qa':\\n        return &amp;lt;Package className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n      case 'tech-strategy-qa':\\n        return &amp;lt;Target className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n      case 'tech-article-qa':\\n        return &amp;lt;Newspaper className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n      case 'technical-translation':\\n        return &amp;lt;FileCode className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n      default:\\n        return &amp;lt;FileText className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 按类别分组历史记录\\n  const groupedHistoryRecords = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const groups: Record&amp;lt;string, SourceInformation[]&amp;gt; = {\\n      'ai-qa-summary': [],\\n      'tech-package-qa': [],\\n      'tech-strategy-qa': [],\\n      'tech-article-qa': [],\\n      'technical-translation': [],\\n      'other': []\\n    };\\n\\n    historyRecords.forEach(record =&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from \\\"./api\\\";\\n\\nexport type SourceCategory = \\n  | \\\"technical-translation\\\"      // 技术转译信息\\n  | \\\"ai-qa-summary\\\"              // AI问答总结信息（通用，从项目资源页面）\\n  | \\\"tech-package-qa\\\"            // 技术包装问答总结信息\\n  | \\\"tech-strategy-qa\\\"           // 技术策略问答总结信息\\n  | \\\"tech-article-qa\\\"            // 技术通稿问答总结\\n  | \\\"external\\\";                  // 外部添加信息（默认）\\n\\nexport interface Source {\\n  id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: \\\"knowledge_base\\\" | \\\"external\\\";\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  category?: SourceCategory;     // 来源类别标识\\n}\\n\\nexport interface SourceInformation {\\n  id?: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: \\\"knowledge_base\\\" | \\\"external\\\";\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  page_type?: \\\"tech-package\\\" | \\\"press-release\\\" | \\\"tech-strategy\\\" | \\\"tech-article\\\";\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  metadata?: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;;\\n  status?: \\\"active\\\" | \\\"archived\\\" | \\\"deleted\\\";\\n  created_by?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AddExternalSourceParams {\\n  title: string;\\n  url?: string;\\n  file?: File;\\n  description?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface KnowledgeBaseItem {\\n  id: number;\\n  title: string;\\n  techPoint?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 从 metadata 中解析 category 的辅助函数\\nconst parseCategoryFromMetadata = (metadata: any): SourceCategory =&amp;gt; {\\n  if (!metadata) return 'external';\\n  \\n  if (typeof metadata === 'object') {\\n    return metadata.category || metadata.sourceCategory || 'external';\\n  } else if (typeof metadata === 'string') {\\n    try {\\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(metadata);\\n      return parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory || 'external';\\n    } catch (e) {\\n      return 'external';\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  return 'external';\\n};\\n\\n// 将 SourceInformation 转换为 Source 的辅助函数\\nconst convertToSource = (item: SourceInformation): Source =&amp;gt; {\\n  const category = parseCategoryFromMetadata(item.metadata);\\n  \\n  return {\\n    id: item.source_id,\\n    title: item.title,\\n    type: item.type,\\n    url: item.url,\\n    description: item.description,\\n    category: category,\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nconst sourceService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 获取知识库列表\\n   */\\n  async getKnowledgeBaseList(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: KnowledgeBaseItem[];\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API，目前先返回空数组\\n      // const response = await api.get('/knowledge-base/list');\\n      // return response.data;\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        data: [],\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"获取知识库列表失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"获取知识库列表失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 添加外部来源\\n   */\\n  async addExternalSource(\\n    params: AddExternalSourceParams\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: Source;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const formData = new FormData();\\n      // if (params.file) {\\n      //   formData.append('file', params.file);\\n      // }\\n      // if (params.url) {\\n      //   formData.append('url', params.url);\\n      // }\\n      // formData.append('title', params.title);\\n      // if (params.description) {\\n      //   formData.append('description', params.description);\\n      // }\\n      // const response = await api.post('/sources/external', formData);\\n      // return response.data;\\n\\n      // 临时实现：直接返回本地创建的对象\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: &amp;#96;external_${Date.now()}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: params.title,\\n        type: \\\"external\\\",\\n        url: params.url,\\n        description: params.description,\\n      };\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        data: source,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"添加外部来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"添加外部来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除来源\\n   */\\n  async deleteSource(sourceId: string): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;/sources/${sourceId}&amp;#96;);\\n      // return response.data;\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"删除来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"删除来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新来源信息\\n   */\\n  async updateSource(\\n    sourceId: string,\\n    updates: Partial&amp;lt;Source&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: Source;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;/sources/${sourceId}&amp;#96;, updates);\\n      // return response.data;\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        data: updates as Source,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"更新来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"更新来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存来源信息到数据库\\n   */\\n  async saveSourceInformation(\\n    source: Source,\\n    pageType?: string,\\n    conversationId?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: SourceInformation;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 构建 metadata，包含 category\\n      const metadata: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n      if (source.category) {\\n        metadata.category = source.category;\\n      }\\n      \\n      const sourceInfo: Partial&amp;lt;SourceInformation&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 29148,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\","

                  "lineNumber": 29319,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// 技术点相关类型定义\\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\\n\\nexport interface TechPoint {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  category_id: number;\\n  type: TechType;\\n  priority: TechPriority;\\n  status: TechStatus;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n  category?: TechCategory;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface TechCategory {\\n  id: number;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  parent_id?: number;\\n  level: number;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n  parent?: TechCategory;\\n  children?: TechCategory[];\\n}\\n\\nexport enum TechType {\\n  FEATURE = 'feature',\\n  IMPROVEMENT = 'improvement',\\n  INNOVATION = 'innovation',\\n  TECHNOLOGY = 'technology'\\n}\\n\\nexport enum TechPriority {\\n  LOW = 'low',\\n  MEDIUM = 'medium',\\n  HIGH = 'high'\\n}\\n\\nexport enum TechStatus {\\n  ACTIVE = 'active',\\n  INACTIVE = 'inactive',\\n  DRAFT = 'draft',\\n  ARCHIVED = 'archived'\\n}\\n\\n// API响应类型\\nexport interface ApiResponse&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TPDSyncService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 同步单个技术点\\n   * @returns {Promise&amp;lt;{created: boolean}&amp;gt;} 返回是否为新创建\\n   */\\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&amp;lt;{ created: boolean }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\\n        &amp;#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&amp;#96;,\\n        {\\n          params: {\\n            includeAssociations: true,\\n          },\\n          timeout: 30000,\\n        }\\n      );\\n\\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\\n\\n      // 准备技术点数据\\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\\n      };\\n\\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\\n      \\n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\\n      if\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { AgentWorkflow, WorkflowExecution, WorkflowTemplate } from '../models/AgentWorkflow';\\nimport { agentWorkflowModel, workflowExecutionModel, workflowTemplateModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\nimport { formatApiResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\nimport DifyClient from './DifyClient';\\nimport { DifyGateway } from '@/shared/infrastructure/integrations/dify';\\nimport { isSuccess } from '@/shared/lib/result';\\nimport { AgentOrchestrator } from './agent/AgentOrchestrator';\\n\\n/**\\n * Agent工作流服务\\n */\\nexport class AgentWorkflowService {\\n  /**\\n   * 验证工作流是否有效\\n   */\\n  async validateWorkflow(workflow: AgentWorkflow): Promise&amp;lt;{ isValid: boolean; errors: string[] }&amp;gt; {\\n    const errors: string[] = [];\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 解析nodes和edges\\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges);\\n\\n      // 检查节点是否为空\\n      if (!Array.isArray(nodes) || nodes.length === 0) {\\n        errors.push('工作流必须至少包含一个节点');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查节点ID唯一性\\n      const nodeIds = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n      for (const node of nodes) {\\n        if (nodeIds.has(node.id)) {\\n          errors.push(&amp;#96;节点ID重复: ${node.id}&amp;#96;);\\n        }\\n        nodeIds.add(node.id);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查边的有效性\\n      for (const edge of edges) {\\n        if (!nodeIds.has(edge.source)) {\\n          errors.push(&amp;#96;边的源节点不存在: ${edge.source}&amp;#96;);\\n        }\\n        if (!nodeIds.has(edge.target)) {\\n          errors.push(&amp;#96;边的目标节点不存在: ${edge.target}&amp;#96;);\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否有环\\n      if (this.hasCycle(nodes, edges)) {\\n        errors.push('工作流包含循环依赖，请检查边的连接');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      errors.push(&amp;#96;JSON解析失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    return {\\n      isValid: errors.length === 0,\\n      errors,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 检查是否有环\\n   */\\n  private hasCycle(nodes: any[], edges: any[]): boolean {\\n    const visited = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n    const recursionStack = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n\\n    const hasCycleFromNode = (nodeId: string): boolean =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (recursionStack.has(nodeId)) {\\n        return true; // 发现环\\n      }\\n\\n      if (visited.has(nodeId)) {\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n\\n      visited.add(nodeId);\\n      recursionStack.add(nodeId);\\n\\n      // 检查所有相邻节点\\n      const outgoingEdges = edges.filter(e =&amp;gt; e.source === nodeId);\\n      for (const edge of outgoingEdges) {\\n        if (hasCycleFromNode(edge.target)) {\\n          return true;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      recursionStack.delete(nodeId);\\n      return false;\\n    };\\n\\n    // 检查每个节点\\n    for (const node of nodes) {\\n      if (!visited.has(node.id)) {\\n        if (hasCycleFromNode(node.id)) {\\n          return true;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建Agent工作流\\n   */\\n  async createWorkflow(data: any): Promise&amp;lt;AgentWorkflow&amp;gt; {\\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.create(data);\\n    \\n    // 验证工作流\\n    const validation = await this.validateWorkflow(workflow);\\n    if (!validation.isValid) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;工作流验证失败: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    return workflow;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有工作流\\n   */\\n  async getAllWorkflows(): Promise&amp;lt;AgentWorkflow[]&amp;gt; {\\n    return await agentWorkflowModel.getAll();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据ID获取工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowById(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AgentWorkflow | null&amp;gt; {\\n    return await agentWorkflowModel.getById(id);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新工作流\\n   */\\n  async updateWorkflow(id: string, data: any): Promise&amp;lt;AgentWorkflow&amp;gt; {\\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.update(id, data);\\n    \\n    // 验证更新后的工作流\\n    const validation = await this.validateWorkflow(workflow);\\n    if (!validation.isValid) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;工作流验证失败: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    return workflow;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除工作流\\n   */\\n  async deleteWorkflow(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    return await agentWorkflowModel.delete(id);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索工作流\\n   */\\n  async searchWorkflows(query: string): Promise&amp;lt;AgentWorkflow[]&amp;gt; {\\n    return await agentWorkflowModel.search(query);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 直接执行AI角色（不通过工作流）\\n   * 支持 Dify 类型和 Direct Agent 类型\\n   * @param roleId AI角色ID\\n   * @param input 输入数据，包含 query、sources、history 等\\n   */\\n  async executeRole(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    input: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&amp;gt; {\\n    logger.info('直接执行AI角色', { roleId, inputKeys: Object.keys(input) });\\n    \\n    // 获取角色配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n    \\n    if (!role.enabled) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色已禁用: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\\n    \\n    // 提取 query\\n    const query = input.query || input.input || input.text || input.content || JSON.stringify(input);\\n    \\n    try {\\n      if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\\n        // Direct Agent 类型：使用 AgentOrchestrator\\n        logger.info('使用 Direct Agent 模式执行', { roleId, edges.forEach(edge =&amp;gt; {\\n      const currentInDegree = inDegree.get(edge.target) || 0;\\n      inDegree.set(edge.target, currentInDegree + 1);\\n\\n      const currentDependents = dependents.get(edge.source) || [];\\n      currentDependents.push(edge.target);\\n      dependents.set(edge.source, currentDependents);\\n    });\\n\\n    const result: any[][] = [];\\n    const queue: any[] = [];\\n    const processed = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n\\n    // 找到所有入度为0的节点（起始节点）\\n    inDegree.forEach((degree, nodeId) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (degree === 0) {\\n        queue.push(nodeMap.get(nodeId)!);\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    // 按层处理，同一层的节点可以并行执行\\n    while (queue.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const levelSize = queue.length;\\n      const level: any[] = [];\\n\\n      for (let i = 0; i &amp;lt; levelSize; i++) {\\n        const node = queue.shift()!;\\n        if (processed.has(node.id)) continue;\\n\\n        level.push(node);\\n        processed.add(node.id);\\n\\n        // 减少依赖节点的入度\\n        const nodeDependents = dependents.get(node.id) || [];\\n        nodeDependents.forEach(dependentId =&amp;gt; {\\n          const currentInDegree = inDegree.get(dependentId) || 0;\\n          inDegree.set(dependentId, currentInDegree - 1);\\n\\n          // 如果入度变为0，加入下一层\\n          if (inDegree.get(dependentId) === 0 &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !processed.has(dependentId)) {\\n            queue.push(nodeMap.get(dependentId)!);\\n          }\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      if (level.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        result.push(level);\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    return result;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行单个节点\\n   */\\n  private async executeNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;,\\n    options: any\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      switch (node.type) {\\n        case 'input':\\n          return this.executeInputNode(node, sharedContext, options);\\n        case 'agent':\\n          return await this.executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext);\\n        case 'output':\\n          return this.executeOutputNode(node, sharedContext);\\n        default:\\n          logger.warn(&amp;#96;未知节点类型: ${node.type}&amp;#96;, { nodeId: node.id });\\n          return { type: node.type, status: 'skipped' };\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error(&amp;#96;节点执行失败: ${node.id}&amp;#96;, { error });\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行输入节点\\n   */\\n  private executeInputNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;,\\n    options: any\\n  ): any {\\n    const data = node.data || {};\\n    const inputs = data.inputs || [];\\n    const workflowInput = sharedContext.workflowInput || {};\\n\\n    logger.info('执行输入节点', {\\n      nodeId: node.id,\\n      inputsCount: inputs.length,\\n      inputNames: inputs.map((i: any) =&amp;gt; i.name),\\n      workflowInputKeys: Object.keys(workflowInput),\\n      hasQuery: !!workflowInput.query,\\n    });\\n\\n    const results: any[] = [];\\n    for (const inputParam of inputs) {\\n      const inputName = inputParam.name || 'input';\\n      let value = workflowInput[inputName];\\n\\n      // 如果字段名为 'input' 但没有值，尝试使用 'query' 字段\\n      if (value === undefined &amp;amp;&amp;amp; inputName === 'input' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; workflowInput.query) {\\n        value = workflowInput.query;\\n        logger.info('输入节点：将query字段映射到input', {\\n          nodeId: node.id,\\n          queryValue: typeof value === 'string' ? value.substring(0, 100) : value,\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      if (value === undefined &amp;amp;&amp;amp; inputParam.defaultValue !== undefined) {\\n        value = inputParam.defaultValue;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (inputParam.required &amp;amp;&amp;amp; value === undefined) {\\n        logger.error('输入节点必需参数未提供', {\\n          nodeId: node.id,\\n          inputName,\\n          availableKeys: name: inputName,\\n        value,\\n        type: inputParam.type || typeof value,\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    logger.info('输入节点执行完成', {\\n      nodeId: node.id,\\n      resultsCount: results.length,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行Agent节点\\n   */\\n  private async executeAgentNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\\n    if (!agentId) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取AI角色配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.enabled) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 准备输入数据\\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\\n    \\n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\\n    // 优先级：query &amp;gt; input &amp;gt; workflowInput.query &amp;gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\\n    if (!query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.input;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\\n    }\\n    if (!query) {\\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\\n    delete inputs.query;\\n    delete inputs.input;\\n\\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 类型的角色。&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const { connectionType, conversationId = nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId;\\n      logger.info('从 nodeInput.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\\n    }\\n    if (!conversationId &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sharedContext.workflowInput?.conversationId) {\\n      conversationId = sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId;\\n      logger.info('从 sharedContext.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!apiKey || !apiUrl) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不完整&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 处理相对路径：如果是相对路径，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) {\\n      // 相对路径，通过后端代理处理，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\\n      actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\\n      logger.info('检测到相对路径，转换为完整URL', {\\n        agentId,\\n        原始: apiUrl,\\n        转换后: actualBaseUrl,\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    logger.info('创建 DifyGateway', {\\n      agentId,\\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      apiKey: apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...',\\n      connectionType,\\n    });\\n\\n    // 创建自定义的DifyGateway\\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({\\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      apiKey,\\n      timeout: 60_000,\\n      maxRetries: 3,\\n    });\\n\\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点', {\\n      nodeId: node.id,\\n      agentId,\\n      connectionType,\\n      query: query?.substring(0, 100),\\n      queryLength: query?.length || 0,\\n      '传递给Dify的conversationId': conversationId || '空（首次对话）',\\n      inputsKeys: Object.keys(inputs || {}),\\n    });\\n\\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\\n      // 使用聊天流模式\\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({\\n        query,\\n        conversationId,\\n answer: chatResponse.answer || result.value.answer,\\n          conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id || result.value.conversationId,\\n          message_id: chatResponse.message_id || {\\n    console.log('[AgentWorkflowService] createTemplate 接收到的数据:', {\\n      name: data.name,\\n      category: data.category,\\n      hasWorkflowStructure: !!data.workflowStructure,\\n      hasWorkflow_structure: !!data.workflow_structure,\\n      workflowStructureType: typeof data.workflowStructure,\\n      workflowStructureKeys: data.workflowStructure &amp;amp;&amp;amp; {\\n    const template = await workflowTemplateModel.getById(templateId);\\n    if (!template) {\\n      throw new Error('模板不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 增加使用次数\\n    await this.incrementTemplateUsage(templateId);\\n\\n    // 解析模板的工作流结构\\n    const workflowStructure = JSON.parse(template.workflow_structure);\\n    \\n    // 应用agent映射\\n    let { nodes } = workflowStructure;\\n    if (options.agentMappings) {\\n      nodes = nodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"class AiSearchService {\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\\n    conversationId?: string;\\\\n    pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release';\\\\n    limit?: number;\\\\n    offset?: number;\\\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\\\n  }): Promise&amp;amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\\\\n      if (options?.category) {\\\\n        params.set('category', options.category);\\\\n      }\\\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\\\n        params.set('conversationId', options.conversationId);\\\\n      }\\\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\\\n        params.set('pageType', options.pageType);\\\\n      }\\\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\\\n        params.set('limit', String(options.limit));\\\\n      }\\\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\\\n        params.set('offset', String(options.offset));\\\\n      }\\\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled !== false) {\\\\n        // 默认排除乱码文件名\\\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'true');\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果明确设置为false，则不排除\\\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'false');\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const query = params.toString();\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/files${query ? &amp;amp;#96;?${query}&amp;amp;#96; : ''}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        return response.data.data;\\\\n      }\\\\n      return [];\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\\\n      return [];\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 上传文件\\\\n   */\\\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    \\\\n  }\\\",\""

new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;amp;#96;);\\\\\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      return null;\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n      return null;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\\\\\n      })),\\\\\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\\\\\n      })),\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\\\\\n    category?: string;\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\nconst filePromises = async (file) =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile({\\n          original_name: originalName,\\n          stored_name: file.filename,\\n          file_path: filePath,\\n          file_url: fileUrl,\\n          mime_type: file.mimetype,\\n          file_size: file.size,\\n          category,\\n          conversation_id: req.body.conversationId || undefined,\\n        });\\n\\n        return fileUrl;\\n      });\\n      \\n      fileUrls = await Promise.all(filePromises);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 获取请求参数（支持JSON和FormData）\\n    let query: string = '';\\n    let inputs: any = {};\\n    let conversationId: string = '';\\n    \\n    if (req.headers['content-type']?.includes('multipart/form-data')) {\\n      // FormData格式\\n      query = req.body.query || '';\\n      try {\\n        inputs = typeof req.body.inputs === 'string' ? JSON.parse(req.body.inputs) : (req.body.inputs || {});\\n      } catch (e) {\\n        inputs = req.body.inputs || {};\\n      }\\n      conversationId = req.body.conversationId || '';\\n    } else {\\n      // JSON格式\\n      query = req.body.query || '';\\n      inputs = req.body.inputs || {};\\n      conversationId = req.body.conversationId || '';\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 获取角色配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!role) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'AI角色不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    if (!role.enabled) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'AI角色已禁用'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 验证查询参数：如果没有查询内容，至少要有文件上传\\n    if ((!query || query.trim() === '') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; fileUrls.length === 0) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'query',\\n        message: '查询内容或文件至少需要提供一个'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n    \\n    console.log('AI角色对话请求:',\\n\\n}\","

category: 'ai'\\n  },\\n  ai_search: {\\n    title: 'AI搜索',\\n    description: 'AI智能搜索助手',\\n    icon: 'Search',\\n    color: '#3B82F6',\\n    category: 'ai'\\n  },\\n  tech_package: {\\n    title:
