= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;amp;gt; \\\\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\\\n      );\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            \\\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 第三组：Agent配置 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n            {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            )}\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 用户标识 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\\\\\"\\\\n                title=\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;User className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;用户&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""
                },

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\\\n-- 创建数据库\\\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\n\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { Request, Response } from 'express';\\\\nimport { techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\\\nimport { CreateTechCategoryDTO, UpdateTechCategoryDTO } from '../types/database';\\\\n\\\\nexport class TechCategoryController {\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 创建技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async create(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const data: CreateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.create(data);\\\\n      res.status(201).json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: category,\\\\n        message: '技术分类创建成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Create tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类详情\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(id);\\\\n      if (!category) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: category\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const {\\\\n        page = 1,\\\\n        pageSize = 20,\\\\n        orderBy = 'sort_order',\\\\n        orderDirection = 'ASC',\\\\n        status,\\\\n        parent_id\\\\n      } = req.query;\\\\n\\\\n      const options = {\\\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\\\\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\\\\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\\\\n        where: {} as any\\\\n      };\\\\n\\\\n      if (status) {\\\\n        options.where.status = status;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\\\\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.findAll(options);\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: result\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech categories error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类列表失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取技术分类树结构\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getTree(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const tree = await techCategoryModel.getTree();\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: tree\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Get tech category tree error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '获取技术分类树失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 更新技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.update(id, data);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (!category) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: category,\\\\n        message: '技术分类更新成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Update tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 删除技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async delete(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const success = await techCategoryModel.delete(id);\\\\n      if (!success) {\\\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        message: '技术分类删除成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Delete tech category error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\\\n   */\\\\n  async search(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const { keyword, page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = req.query;\\\\n      \\\\n      if (!keyword) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '搜索关键词不能为空'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const options = {\\\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string)\\\\n      };\\\\n\\\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.search(keyword as string, options);\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: result\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Search tech categories error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '搜索技术分类失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 批量更新排序\\\\n   */\\\\n  async updateSortOrder(req: Request, res: Response) {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const { items } = req.body;\\\\n      \\\\n      if (!Array.isArray(items)) {\\\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\\\n          success: false,\\\\n          message: '无效的排序数据'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      await techCategoryModel.updateSortOrder(items);\\\\n      res.json({\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        message: '排序更新成功'\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('Update sort order error:', error);\\\\n      res.status(500).json({\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        message: '更新排序失败'\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""

utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\\\nUSE todify3;\\\\n\\\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\\\n    slides_url COMMENT '生成参数',\\\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\\\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\\\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\\\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\\\\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\\\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\\\\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\\\\n    INDEX                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Bot,\\\\n  Workflow,\\\\n  MessageSquare,\\\\n  Layers,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;h1 className=\\\\\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/h1&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n          {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"        \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"/**\\\\\\\\n * 获取文件列表\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    await initializeFileTable();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\\\\\\\\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\\\\\\\\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\\\\\\\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\\\\\\\\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\\\\\\\\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\\\\\\\\n      category,\\\\\\\\n      conversationId,\\\\\\\\n      pageType,\\\\\\\\n      limit,\\\\\\\\n      offset,\\\\\\\\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\\\\\n      id: file.file_id,\\\\\\\\n      fileId: file.file_id,\\\\\\\\n      name: file.original_name,\\\\\\\\n      url: file.file_url,\\\\\\\\n      type: file.mime_type,\\\\\\\\n      size: file.file_size,\\\\\\\\n      category: file.category,\\\\\\\\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\\\\\\\\n      description: file.description,\\\\\\\\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\\\\\\\\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\\\\\\\\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\\\\\\\\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\\\\\\\\n    }));\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    res.json(\\\\\\\\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(\\\\\\\\n      formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n        false,\\\\\\\\n        null,\\\\\\\\n        '获取文件列表失败',\\\\\\\\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n      )\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 删除文件（软删除）\\\\\\\\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\\\\n\\\\n## 一、概述\\\\n\\\\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\\\\n\\\\n### 1.1 设计目标\\\\n\\\\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\\\\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\\\\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\\\\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\\\\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\\\\n\\\\n### 1.2 架构分层\\\\n\\\\n数据库架构分为五层：\\\\n\\\\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\\\\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\\\\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\\\\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\\\\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\\\\n\\\\n## 二、表结构设计\\\\n\\\\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\\\\n\\\\n存储汽车品牌信息。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\\\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\\\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\\\\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\\\\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\\\\n\\\\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\\\\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\\\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\\\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\\\n\\\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\\\n\\\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\\\n\\\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\\\n\\\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\\\\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\\\\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\\\\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\\\n\\\\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\\\\n\\\\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\\\\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\\\\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\\\\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\\\\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\\\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\\\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\\\\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\\\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\\\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\\\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\\\\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\\\\n\\\\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\\\\n\\\\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\\\\n\\\\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\\\\n\\\\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\\\\n\\\\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\\\\n\\\\n存储Agent工作流定义。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\\\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\\\\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\\\\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\\\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\\\\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\\\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.4.2 工作流执行表 (workflow_executions) - 统一表\\\\n\\\\n**重要**：此表合并了Agent工作流执行和Dify工作流执行记录，通过&amp;amp;#96;execution_type&amp;amp;#96;字段区分。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\\\n| execution_type | TEXT | 执行类型：'agent_workflow' 或 'dify_workflow' |\\\\n| workflow_id | TEXT | Agent工作流ID（外键，agent_workflows.id） |\\\\n| workflow_name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\\\n| shared_context | TEXT | JSON字符串，共享上下文（Agent工作流） |\\\\n| node_results | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点执行结果（Agent工作流） |\\\\n| workflow_run_id | TEXT | Dify工作流运行ID（唯一） |\\\\n| task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\\\n| message_id | TEXT | 关联消息ID（外键，chat_messages.message_id） |\\\\n| app_type | TEXT | 应用类型（Dify工作流） |\\\\n| status | TEXT | 执行状态 |\\\\n| error_message | TEXT | 错误信息 |\\\\n| inputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输入 |\\\\n| outputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输出 |\\\\n| elapsed_time | REAL | 执行时间（秒） |\\\\n| total_tokens | INTEGER | 总token数 |\\\\n| total_steps | INTEGER | 总步数 |\\\\n| duration | INTEGER | 持续时间（毫秒，Agent工作流） |\\\\n| start_time | TIMESTAMP | 开始时间 |\\\\n| end_time | TIMESTAMP | 结束时间 |\\\\n| started_at | DATETIME | 开始时间（Dify工作流） |\\\\n| finished_at | DATETIME | 完成时间（Dify工作流） |\\\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.4.3 对话会话表 (conversations)\\\\n\\\\n存储对话会话信息。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.4.4 聊天消息表 (chat_messages)\\\\n\\\\n存储聊天消息，关联对话会话。\\\\n\\\\n### 2.5 第五层：配置与统计层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.5.1 AI角色表 (ai_roles)\\\\n\\\\n存储AI角色配置。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\\\n| name | TEXT | 角色名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\\\\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\\\\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\\\\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\\\\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\\\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;json\\\\n{\\\\n  \\\\\\\"apiUrl\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"string\\\\\\\",\\\\n  \\\\\\\"apiKey\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"string\\\\\\\",\\\\n  \\\\\\\"connectionType\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"chatflow\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"workflow\\\\\\\",\\\\n  \\\\\\\"inputFields\\\\\\\": [...]\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\\\\n\\\\n存储公开页面配置。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\\\\n\\\\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\\\\n\\\\n存储上传的文件信息。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\\\\n\\\\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\\\\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\\\\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\\\\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\\\\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\\\\n\\\\n## 三、关键设计决策\\\\n\\\\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\\\\n\\\\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&amp;amp;#96;workflow_executions&amp;amp;#96;表定义：\\\\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\\\\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\\\\n\\\\n**解决方案**：\\\\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\\\\n- 添加&amp;amp;#96;execution_type&amp;amp;#96;字段区分类型\\\\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\\\\n\\\\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\\\\n\\\\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\\\\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\\\\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\\\\n\\\\n### 3.3 命名规范\\\\n\\\\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\\\\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\\\\n- **索引名**：统一格式&amp;amp;#96;idx_表名_字段名&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\\\\n\\\\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;dify_config&amp;amp;#96; - Dify配置\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;nodes&amp;amp;#96;、&amp;amp;#96;edges&amp;amp;#96; - 工作流结构\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;metadata&amp;amp;#96; - 元数据\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;tags&amp;amp;#96;、&amp;amp;#96;keywords&amp;amp;#96; - 数组数据\\\\n\\\\n## 四、索引设计\\\\n\\\\n### 4.1 索引策略\\\\n\\\\n1. **主键索引**：自动创建\\\\n2. **外键索引**：为所有外键字段创建索引\\\\n3. **查询索引**：为常用查询字段创建索引\\\\n4. **复合索引**：为多字段组合查询创建复合索引\\\\n\\\\n### 4.2 重要索引\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type&amp;amp;#96; - 按执行类型查询\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type_status&amp;amp;#96; - 按类型和状态查询\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;idx_tech_points_category_status&amp;amp;#96; - 按分类和状态查询\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;idx_chat_messages_conv_status&amp;amp;#96; - 按对话和状态查询\\\\n\\\\n## 五、数据迁移\\\\n\\\\n### 5.1 迁移机制\\\\n\\\\n使用&amp;amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;amp;#96;表记录所有迁移历史：\\\\n- migration_name: 迁移文件名\\\\n- version: 版本号\\\\n- executed_at: 执行时间\\\\n- execution_time_ms: 执行耗时\\\\n- status: 执行状态\\\\n- error_message: 错误信息\\\\n\\\\n### 5.2 迁移工具\\\\n\\\\n使用&amp;amp;#96;migrate.ts&amp;amp;#96;工具执行迁移：\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;bash\\\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## 六、使用说明\\\\n\\\\n### 6.1 初始化数据库\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;bash\\\\n# SQLite\\\\nDB_TYPE=sqlite DB_PATH=./database.db ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\\\n\\\\n# PostgreSQL\\\\nDB_TYPE=postgresql PGHOST=localhost PGDATABASE=todify2 PGUSER=postgres ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 6.2 执行迁移\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;bash\\\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 6.3 查看迁移状态\\\\n\\\\n迁移工具会自动记录执行状态到&amp;amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;amp;#96;表。\\\\n\\\\n## 七、注意事项\\\\n\\\\n1. **向后兼容**：新架构保持与现有代码的兼容性\\\\n2. **数据备份**：执行迁移前必须备份现有数据\\\\n3. **测试验证**：在测试环境充分验证新架构\\\\n4. **性能测试**：验证索引优化后的查询性能\\\\n5. **文档更新**：同步更新API文档和开发文档\\\\n\\\\n## 八、版本历史\\\\n\\\\n- **v2.0** (2025-01-XX): 统一数据库架构，解决表冲突，规范化命名\\\\n- **v1.0**: 初始分散的数据库架构\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\\\\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\\\\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\\\\n\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n-- 品牌表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\\\n    country TEXT,\\\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 车型表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\n    name_en TEXT,\\\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 车系表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    metadata TEXT,\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术分类表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\\\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n-- 知识点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\\\n    source_query TEXT,\\\\n    source_url TEXT,\\\\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\\\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\\\n    notes TEXT,\\\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\\\n\\\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\\\n\\\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\\\n\\\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\\\n\\\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\\\n\\\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\\\n\\\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\\\n\\\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\\\n|--------|------|------|\\\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 5990,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"# 三层级车系架构设计\\\\n\\\\n## 概述\\\\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\\\\n\\\\n## 层级关系\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n品牌 (Brand)\\\\n├── 车型 (Model) \\\\n    ├── 车系 (Series)\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## 数据库设计\\\\n\\\\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;sql\\\\nCREATE TABLE brands (\\\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\\\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\\\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\\\\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\\\\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\\\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\\\\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\\\n);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;sql\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\\\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\\\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\\\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\\\\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\\\\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\\\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\\\\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\\\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\\\\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\\\\n);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;sql\\\\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\\\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\\\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\\\n    description TEXT,\\\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\\\n-- ==============================================\\\\n\\\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\\",\""

error.message : String(error),\\\\n            });\\\\n            // 即使转换失败，也继续上传文件\\\\n          }\\\\n\\\\n          // 构建metadata，包含pageType和markdown内容\\\\n          const metadata: any = pageType ? { pageType } : {};\\\\n          if (markdownContent) {\\\\n            metadata.markdownContent = markdownContent;\\\\n          }\\\\n\\\\n          const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile({\\\\n            original_name: originalName,\\\\n            stored_name: file.filename,\\\\n            file_path: filePath,\\\\n            file_url: fileUrl,\\\\n            mime_type: file.mimetype,\\\\n            file_size: file.size,\\\\n            category,\\\\n            conversation_id: conversationId || undefined,\\\\n            uploader_id: uploaderId || undefined,\\\\n            metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ?                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"/**\\\\n * 获取文件列表\\\\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    await initializeFileTable();\\\\n\\\\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\\\\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\\\\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\\\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\\\\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\\\\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\\\\n\\\\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\\\\n      category,\\\\n      conversationId,\\\\n      pageType,\\\\n      limit,\\\\n      offset,\\\\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: file.file_id,\\\\n      fileId: file.file_id,\\\\n      name: file.original_name,\\\\n      url: file.file_url,\\\\n      type: file.mime_type,\\\\n      size: file.file_size,\\\\n      category: file.category,\\\\n      tags: file.tags ?
