                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Bot,\\\\n  Workflow,\\\\n  MessageSquare,\\\\n  Layers,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;h1 className=\\\\\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/h1&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n          {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;                   "lineNumber": 1869,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\\n\\n## 一、概述\\n\\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\\n\\n### 1.1 设计目标\\n\\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\\n\\n### 1.2 架构分层\\n\\n数据库架构分为五层：\\n\\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\\n\\n## 二、表结构设计\\n\\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\\n\\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\\n\\n存储汽车品牌信息。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\\n\\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\n\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\n\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\n\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\n\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\n\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\n\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n\\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n\\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\\n\\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\\n\\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\\n\\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\\n\\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\\n\\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\\n\\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\\n\\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\\n\\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\\n\\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\\n\\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\\n\\n存储Agent工作流定义。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.4.2 工作流执行表 (workflow_executions) - 执行类型：'agent_workflow' 或 'dify_workflow' |\\n| workflow_id | TEXT | Agent工作流ID（外键，agent_workflows.id） |\\n| workflow_name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\n| shared_context | TEXT | JSON字符串，共享上下文（Agent工作流） |\\n| node_results | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点执行结果（Agent工作流） |\\n| workflow_run_id | TEXT | Dify工作流运行ID（唯一） |\\n| task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\n| message_id | TEXT | 关联消息ID（外键，chat_messages.message_id） |\\n| app_type | TEXT | 应用类型（Dify工作流） |\\n| status | TEXT | 执行状态 |\\n| error_message | TEXT | 错误信息 |\\n| inputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输入 |\\n| outputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输出 |\\n| elapsed_time | REAL | 执行时间（秒） |\\n| total_tokens | INTEGER | 总token数 |\\n| total_steps | INTEGER | 总步数 |\\n| duration | INTEGER | 持续时间（毫秒，Agent工作流） |\\n| start_time | TIMESTAMP | 开始时间 |\\n| end_time | TIMESTAMP | 结束时间 |\\n| started_at | (conversations)\\n\\n存储对话会话信息。\\n\\n#### 2.4.4 聊天消息表 (chat_messages)\\n\\n存储聊天消息，关联对话会话。\\n\\n### 2.5 第五层：配置与统计层\\n\\n#### 2.5.1 AI角色表 (ai_roles)\\n\\n存储AI角色配置。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\n| name | TEXT | 角色名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\n\\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;json\\n{\\n  \\\"apiUrl\\\": \\\"string\\\",\\n  \\\"apiKey\\\": \\\"string\\\",\\n  \\\"connectionType\\\": \\\"chatflow\\\" | \\\"workflow\\\",\\n  \\\"inputFields\\\": [...]\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\\n\\n存储公开页面配置。\\n\\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\\n\\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\\n\\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\\n\\n存储上传的文件信息。\\n\\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\\n\\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\\n\\n## 三、关键设计决策\\n\\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\\n\\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&amp;#96;workflow_executions&amp;#96;表定义：\\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\\n\\n**解决方案**：\\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\\n- 添加&amp;#96;execution_type&amp;#96;字段区分类型\\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\\n\\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\\n\\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\\n\\n### 3.3 命名规范\\n\\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\\n- **索引名**：统一格式&amp;#96;idx_表名_字段名&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\\n\\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\\n- &amp;#96;dify_config&amp;#96; - Dify配置\\n- &amp;#96;nodes&amp;#96;、&amp;#96;edges&amp;#96; - 工作流结构\\n- &amp;#96;metadata&amp;#96; - 元数据\\n- &amp;#96;tags&amp;#96;、&amp;#96;keywords&amp;#96; - 数组数据\\n\\n## 四、索引设计\\n\\n### 4.1 索引策略\\n\\n1. **主键索引**：自动创建\\n2. **外键索引**：为所有外键字段创建索引\\n3. **查询索引**：为常用查询字段创建索引\\n4. **复合索引**：为多字段组合查询创建复合索引\\n\\n### 4.2 重要索引\\n\\n- &amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type&amp;#96; - 按执行类型查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type_status&amp;#96; - 按类型和状态查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_tech_points_category_status&amp;#96; - 按分类和状态查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_chat_messages_conv_status&amp;#96; - 按对话和状态查询\\n\\n## 五、数据迁移\\n\\n### 5.1 迁移机制\\n\\n使用&amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;#96;表记录所有迁移历史：\\n- migration_name: 迁移文件名\\n- version: 版本号\\n- executed_at: 执行时间\\n- execution_time_ms: 执行耗时\\n- status: 执行状态\\n- error_message: 错误信息\\n\\n### 5.2 迁移工具\\n\\n使用&amp;#96;migrate.ts&amp;#96;工具执行迁移：\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 六、使用说明\\n\\n### 6.1 初始化数据库\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# SQLite\\nDB_TYPE=sqlite DB_PATH=./database.db ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\n\\n# PostgreSQL\\nDB_TYPE=postgresql PGHOST=localhost PGDATABASE=todify2 PGUSER=postgres ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 6.2 执行迁移\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 6.3 查看迁移状态\\n\\n迁移工具会自动记录执行状态到&amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;#96;表。\\n\\n## 七、注意事项\\n\\n1. **向后兼容**：新架构保持与现有代码的兼容性\\n2. **数据备份**：执行迁移前必须备份现有数据\\n3. **测试验证**：在测试环境充分验证新架构\\n4. **性能测试**：验证索引优化后的查询性能\\n5. **文档更新**：同步更新API文档和开发文档\\n\\n## 八、版本历史\\n\\n- **v2.0** (2025-01-XX): 统一数据库架构，解决表冲突，规范化命名\\n- **v1.0**: 初始分散的数据库架构\\n\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 品牌表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\n    country TEXT,\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 车型表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 车系表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\n    description TEXT,\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    metadata TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    published_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术演讲稿表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n     -- 完成时间（Dify工作流）\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    \\n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 对话会话表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY                   "lineNumber": 4651,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\\n\\n## 一、概述\\n\\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\\n\\n### 1.1 设计目标\\n\\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\\n\\n### 1.2 架构分层\\n\\n数据库架构分为五层：\\n\\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\\n\\n## 二、表结构设计\\n\\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\\n\\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\\n\\n存储汽车品牌信息。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\\n\\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 4860,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5299,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\n\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\n\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\n\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\n\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\n\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\n\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 5637,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 三层级车系架构设计\\n\\n## 概述\\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\\n\\n## 层级关系\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n品牌 (Brand)\\n├── 车型 (Model) \\n    ├── 车系 (Series)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 数据库设计\\n\\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE brands (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\\n);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 20962,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

error.message : String(error),\\n            });\\n            // 即使转换失败，也继续上传文件\\n          }\\n\\n          // 构建metadata，包含pageType和markdown内容\\n          const metadata: any = pageType ? { pageType } : {};\\n          if (markdownContent) {\\n            metadata.markdownContent = markdownContent;\\n          }\\n\\n          const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile({\\n            original_name: originalName,\\n            stored_name: file.filename,\\n            file_path: filePath,\\n            file_url: fileUrl,\\n            mime_type: file.mimetype,\\n            file_size: file.size,\\n            category,\\n            conversation_id: conversationId || undefined,\\n            uploader_id: uploaderId || undefined,\\n            metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &amp;gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\\n          });\\n\\n          // markdownContent已经在上面提取并存储在metadata中，直接使用\\n\\n          return {\\n            id: fileRecord.file_id,\\n            fileId: fileRecord.file_id,\\n            name: fileRecord.original_name,\\n            url: fileRecord.file_url,\\n            type: fileRecord.mime_type,\\n            size: fileRecord.file_size,\\n            category: fileRecord.category,\\n            createdAt: fileRecord.created_at,\\n            markdownContent, // 包含markdown内容\\n          };\\n        })\\n      );\\n\\n      res.json(\\n        formatApiResponse(true, uploadedFiles, '文件上传成功并已保存到数据库')\\n      );\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json(\\n        formatApiResponse\\n\\n\\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 5224,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 与指定AI角色对话\\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n * 支持multipart/form-data（带文件）和application/json（不带文件）\\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\\n */\\nrouter.post('/:id/chat', upload.array('files', 10), async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    \\n    // 处理文件上传\\n    const uploadedFiles = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\\n    let fileUrls: string[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (uploadedFiles &amp;amp;&amp;amp; uploadedFiles.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      // 保存文件到数据库并获取文件URL\\n      const filePromises = uploadedFiles.map(async (file) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const filePath = file.path;\\n        const fileUrl = &amp;#96;/uploads/ai-roles/${file.filename}&amp;#96;;\\n        \\n        // 确定文件分类\\n        let category = 'general';\\n        if (file.mimetype.startsWith('image/')) {\\n          category = 'image';\\n        } else if (file.mimetype.startsWith('application/pdf') || \\n                   file.mimetype.includes('document') || \\n                   file.mimetype.includes('word') ||\\n                   file.mimetype.includes('text')) {\\n          category = 'document';\\n        }\\n\\n        // 处理文件名编码\\n        let originalName = file.originalname;\\n        try {\\n          const hasGarbledChars = /ã€|ç¥|æ|Ã|â€|â€|â€/.test(originalName);\\n          if (hasGarbledChars) {\\n            const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\\n            const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\\n            if (/[\\\\u4e00-\\\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded)) {\\n              originalName = decoded;\\n            }\\n          }\\n        } catch (e) {\\n          // 忽略编码错误，使用原始文件名\\n        }\\n\\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile\\n;\\n      };\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 6904,

JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ? JSON.stringify(params.metadata) : null;\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        INSERT INTO files (\\n          file_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_url,\\n          mime_type, file_size, file_hash, category, tags, description,\\n          uploader_id, conversation_id, metadata\\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      await db.query(sql, [\\n        fileId,\\n        params.original_name,\\n        params.stored_name,\\n        params.file_path,\\n        params.file_url,\\n        params.mime_type,\\n        params.file_size,\\n        fileHash || null,\\n        params.category || 'general',\\n        tagsJson,\\n        params.description || null,\\n        params.uploader_id || null,\\n        params.conversation_id || null,\\n        metadataJson,\\n      ]);\\n\\n      const file = await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      if (!file) {\\n        throw new Error('创建文件记录失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('文件记录创建成功', { fileId, originalName: params.original_name });\\n      return file;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('创建文件记录失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据文件ID获取文件记录\\n   */\\n  async getFileByFileId(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 11361,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 11885,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 文件存储表\\n-- 用于存储上传的文件信息，支持后续反复调用\\n\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n  file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\\n  original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\\n  stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\\n  file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\\n  file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\\n  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\\n  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\\n  file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\\n  category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类（general, document, image等）\\n  tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\\n  description TEXT, -- 文件描述\\n  uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\\n  conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\\n  usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\\n  last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n  metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);\","
                },
                {

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 11999,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\","

                  "lineNumber": 12101,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "lineNumber": 15068,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechPointModel {\\nasync findById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术点\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ?                   "lineNumber": 16414,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TechPointModel {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE status = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\\n\\n    if (categoryId) {\\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\\n      values.push(categoryId);\\n    }\\n\\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const techPointMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有技术点\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootTechPoints;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术点\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 获取文件列表\\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\\n */\\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    await initializeFileTable();\\n\\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n\\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\\n      category,\\n      conversationId,\\n      pageType,\\n      limit,\\n      offset,\\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n    });\\n\\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: file.file_id,\\n      fileId: file.file_id,\\n      name: file.original_name,\\n      url: file.file_url,\\n      type: file.mime_type,\\n      size: file.file_size,\\n      category: file.category,\\n      tags: file.tags ?                   "lineNumber": 18360,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            \\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n            {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from './api';\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\nimport {\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\n  Message,\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\n  Source,\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\n */\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","
