                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            \\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第三组：Agent配置 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n            {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n\\n            {/* 用户标识 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                title=\\\"用户\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;用户&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","
                }

                  "content": "Now I am creating API endpoints for the public knowledge base, based on my understanding of common setups. I've designed &#96;/api/upload&#96; and &#96;/api/knowledge&#96;, among others, and I am currently considering the category endpoints and database schema for the &#96;KnowledgeCategory&#96; and &#96;KnowledgeItem&#96; models, based on the technology I expect to find."

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\\n-- 创建数据库\\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\\nUSE todify3;\\n\\n-- 1. 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    car_model_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '车型ID',\\n    application_status ENUM('计划中', '开发中', '测试中', '已应用', '已停用') DEFAULT '计划中' COMMENT '应用状态',\\n    start_date DATE COMMENT '开始应用日期',\\n    end_date DATE COMMENT '停止应用日期',\\n    notes TEXT COMMENT '备注',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_tech_car (tech_point_id, car_model_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_car_model (car_model_id),\\n    INDEX idx_status (application_status),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 5. 技术包装材料表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_packaging_materials (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的技术点ID',\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '包装内容',\\n    content_type ENUM('文档', '图片', '视频', '演示') DEFAULT '文档' COMMENT '内容类型',\\n    target_audience ENUM('技术人员', '市场人员', '客户', '媒体', '通用') DEFAULT '通用' COMMENT '目标受众',\\n    language VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'zh-CN' COMMENT '语言',\\n    version VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '1.0' COMMENT '版本号',\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已发布', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\n    reviewed_by BIGINT COMMENT '审核人ID',\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '发布时间',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\n    INDEX idx_type (content_type),\\n    INDEX idx_audience (target_audience),\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);-- 6. 技术推广策略表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_promotion_strategies (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '策略标题',\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '策略内容',\\n    strategy_type ENUM('市场推广', '技术推广', '品牌推广', '产品推广') DEFAULT '技术推广' COMMENT '策略类型',\\n    target_market VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '目标市场',\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '预算范围',\\n    timeline VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '时间计划',\\n    success_metrics JSON COMMENT '成功指标',\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '执行中', '已完成', '已暂停') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_type (strategy_type),\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- 7. 技术通稿表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_press_releases (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿标题',\\n    subtitle VARCHAR(300) COMMENT '副标题',\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿内容',\\n    summary TEXT COMMENT '摘要',\\n    press_type ENUM('新技术发布', '技术突破', '合作公告', '产品发布', '其他') DEFAULT '新技术发布' COMMENT '通稿类型',\\n    target_media JSON COMMENT '目标媒体列表',\\n    keywords JSON COMMENT '关键词',\\n    release_date DATE COMMENT '计划发布日期',\\n    embargo_date DATETIME COMMENT '禁发时间',\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已发布', '已撤回') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\n    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '实际发布时间',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_type (press_type),\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\n    INDEX idx_release_date (release_date),\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\n);-- 8. 发布会演讲稿表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_speeches (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿标题',\\n    content LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿内容',\\n    speech_type ENUM('产品发布会', '技术大会', '媒体见面会', '内部分享', '其他') DEFAULT '产品发布会' COMMENT '演讲类型',\\n    duration_minutes INT COMMENT '预计时长（分钟）',\\n    target_audience VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '目标听众',\\n    event_name VARCHAR(200) COMMENT '活动名称',\\n    event_date DATE COMMENT '活动日期',\\n    speaker_notes LONGTEXT COMMENT '演讲者备注',\\n    slides_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'PPT链接',\\n    status ENUM('草稿', '审核中', '已批准', '已使用', '已归档') DEFAULT '草稿' COMMENT '状态',\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Dify任务ID',\\n    generation_params JSON COMMENT '生成参数',\\n    created_by BIGINT COMMENT '创建人ID',\\n    approved_by BIGINT COMMENT '批准人ID',\\n    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '使用时间',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_type (speech_type),\\n    INDEX idx_status (status),\\n    INDEX idx_event_date (event_date),\\n    INDEX idx_dify_task (dify_task_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- 9. 推广策略与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\\n    id '提及类型',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\\n                   "lineNumber": 2847,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"# 公共知识库 implementation plan\\n\\n## 1. 数据库设计 (Database Design)\\n我们将创建两个新表来管理公共知识库的分类和文件。将采用项目现有的 &amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;#96; 模式进行表初始化。\\n\\n### 1.1 表结构\\n*   **&amp;#96;public_knowledge_categories&amp;#96;**: 存储分类目录结构\\n    *   &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\n    *   &amp;#96;name&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (分类名称)\\n    *   &amp;#96;parent_id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (父分类ID, 支持无限层级)\\n    *   &amp;#96;sort_order&amp;#96;: INT (排序)\\n    *   &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\n*   **&amp;#96;public_knowledge_files&amp;#96;**: 存储文件信息\\n    *   &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\n    *   &amp;#96;category_id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (关联分类)\\n    *   &amp;#96;name&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件名)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_path&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (存储路径/URL)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_type&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件类型 mime-type)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_size&amp;#96;: BIGINT (文件大小)\\n    *   &amp;#96;description&amp;#96;: TEXT (描述)\\n    *   &amp;#96;uploaded_by&amp;#96;: BIGINT (上传者ID, 可选)\\n    *   &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\n\\n## 2. 后端开发 (Backend Development)\\n*   **Model**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/models/PublicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96;，实现 &amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;#96; 方法。\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;#96; 处理业务逻辑（如文件上传处理、递归删除分类等）。\\n*   **Controller**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/controllers/PublicKnowledgeController.ts&amp;#96; 暴露 RESTful 接口。\\n*   **Router**: 在 &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96; 定义路由，并注册到 &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/index.ts&amp;#96;。\\n    *   &amp;#96;GET /categories&amp;#96;: 获取分类树\\n    *   &amp;#96;POST /categories&amp;#96;: 创建分类\\n    *   &amp;#96;POST /upload&amp;#96;: 上传文件 (使用 &amp;#96;multer&amp;#96;)\\n    *   &amp;#96;GET /files&amp;#96;: 获取文件列表 (支持按分类筛选)\\n    *   &amp;#96;DELETE /files/:id&amp;#96;: 删除文件\\n\\n## 3. 前端开发 (Frontend Development)\\n*   **Types**: 定义 &amp;#96;frontend/src/types/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96; 类型。\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;#96; 调用后端 API。\\n*   **Pages**: 创建 &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/PublicKnowledge/index.tsx&amp;#96; 作为主页面。\\n*   **Components**:\\n    *   &amp;#96;CategorySidebar&amp;#96;: 左侧分类树组件 (支持新建、重命名)。\\n    *   &amp;#96;FileList&amp;#96;: 右侧文件列表 (Grid/List 视图)。\\n    *   &amp;#96;UploadModal&amp;#96;: 文件上传弹窗 (支持拖拽)。\\n\\n## 4. 存储策略 (Storage Strategy)\\n*   当前阶段使用本地存储 (&amp;#96;backend/uploads/public-knowledge/&amp;#96;)。\\n*   未来可扩展为对象存储 (S3/OSS)。\\n\\n## 5. 实施步骤 (Implementation Steps)\\n1.  后端：创建数据模型与数据库表。\\n2.  后端：实现文件上传与分类管理的 API。\\n3.  前端：实现 API Service 层。\\n4.  前端：开发分类侧边栏与文件列表页面。\\n5.  联调与测试。\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 2876,
                  "content": "  \"overview\": \"Implementation of a Public Knowledge Base feature allowing file uploads and category management. This will involve backend database changes, API endpoints, and a frontend file manager interface.\""

                {
                  "lineNumber": 3002,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\nimport { \\n  TechCategory, \\n  CreateTechCategoryDTO, \\n  UpdateTechCategoryDTO, \\n  QueryOptions, \\n  PaginatedResult,\\n  Status \\n} from '../types/database';\\n\\nexport class TechCategoryModel {\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\n\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\n    this.db = db;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建技术分类\\n   */\\n  async create(data: CreateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status)\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      data.name,\\n      data.description || null,\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\n      data.level || 1,\\n      data.sort_order || 0,\\n      data.status || Status.ACTIVE\\n    ];\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result[0] as TechCategory;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据ID获取技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术分类\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\n    \\n    return {\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\n      total,\\n      page,\\n      pageSize,\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子分类\\n   */\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result as TechCategory[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取分类树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE status = ? \\n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const categoryMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp;amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有分类\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    categories.forEach(category =&amp;gt; {\\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootCategories;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术分类\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechCategory | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\n        fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\n      return this.findById(id);\\n    }\\n\\n    values.push(id);\\n    \\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? result[0] as TechCategory : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_categories \\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 物理删除技术分类\\n   */\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子分类\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_categories WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.affectedRows &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\n   */\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechCategory&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    const searchOptions = {\\n      ...options,\\n      where: {\\n        ...options.where,\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?) AND status = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const searchTerm = &amp;#96;%${keyword}%&amp;#96;;\\n    const values = [searchTerm, searchTerm, Status.ACTIVE];\\n\\n    // 添加额外的WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        if (key !== 'name' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; key !== 'description') {\\n          sql += &amp;#96; AND ${key} = ?&amp;#96;;\\n          values.push(value);\\n        }\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\n    \\n    return {\\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\\n      total,\\n      page,\\n      pageSize,\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 批量更新排序\\n   */\\n  async updateSortOrder(updates: { id: number; sort_order: number }[]): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    const transaction = await this.db.transaction();\\n    \\n    try {\\n      for (const update of updates) {\\n        const sql = &amp;#96;\\n          UPDATE tech_categories \\n          SET sort_order = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n          WHERE id = ?\\n        &amp;#96;;\\n        await transaction.query(sql, [update.sort_order, update.id]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      await transaction.commit();\\n      return true;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      await transaction.rollback();\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 3032,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { db } from '@/config/database';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\nimport crypto from 'crypto';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport path from 'path';\\n\\nexport interface FileRecord {\\n  id: number;\\n  file_id: string;\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category: string;\\n  tags?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  usage_count: number;\\n  last_used_at?: string;\\n  status: 'active' | 'archived' | 'deleted';\\n  metadata?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface CreateFileParams {\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category?: string;\\n  tags?: string[];\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n}\\n\\nexport class FileService {\\n  /**\\n   * 初始化文件表\\n   */\\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n          file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\\n          original_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          stored_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_url TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n          file_hash TEXT,\\n          category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',\\n          tags TEXT,\\n          description TEXT,\\n          uploader_id TEXT,\\n          conversation_id TEXT,\\n          usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\n          last_used_at DATETIME,\\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n          metadata TEXT,\\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        );\\n\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      // 执行多个SQL语句\\n      const statements = sql.split(';').filter(s =&amp;gt; s.trim());\\n      for (const statement of statements) {\\n        if (statement.trim()) {\\n          await db.query(statement);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      logger.info('文件表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('文件表初始化失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 计算文件哈希值\\n   */\\n  private async calculateFileHash(filePath: string): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');\\n      const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);\\n\\n      stream.on('data', (data) =&amp;gt; hash.update(data));\\n      stream.on('end', () =&amp;gt; resolve(hash.digest('hex')));\\n      stream.on('error', reject);\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成文件ID\\n   */\\n  private generateFileId(): string {\\n    return &amp;#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15)}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建文件记录\\n   */\\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 计算文件哈希值\\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\\n        \\n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\\n        if (existing) {\\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\\n          return existing;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ? JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ? JSON.stringify(params.metadata) : null;\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        INSERT INTO files (\\n          file_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_url,\\n          mime_type, file_size, file_hash, category, tags, description,\\n          uploader_id, conversation_id, metadata\\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      await db.query(sql, [\\n        fileId,\\n        params.original_name,\\n        params.stored_name,\\n        params.file_path,\\n        params.file_url,\\n        params.mime_type,\\n        params.file_size,\\n        fileHash || null,\\n        params.category || 'general',\\n        tagsJson,\\n        params.description || null,\\n        params.uploader_id || null,\\n        params.conversation_id || null,\\n        metadataJson,\\n      ]);\\n\\n      const file = await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      if (!file) {\\n        throw new Error('创建文件记录失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('文件记录创建成功', { fileId, originalName: params.original_name });\\n      return file;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('创建文件记录失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据文件ID获取文件记录\\n   */\\n  async getFileByFileId(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_id = ? AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件记录失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据哈希值查找文件\\n   */\\n  async findByHash(fileHash: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_hash = ? AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileHash]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('根据哈希查找文件失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 增加文件使用次数\\n   */\\n  async incrementUsageCount(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        UPDATE files \\n        SET usage_count = usage_count + 1,\\n            last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        WHERE file_id = ?\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('增加文件使用次数失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    status?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\n    limit?: number;\\n    offset?: number;\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      let sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&amp;#96;;\\n      const params: any[] = [];\\n\\n      if (options?.category) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND category = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.status) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.status);\\n      } else {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND conversation_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(&amp;#96;%\\\"pageType\\\":\\\"${options.pageType}\\\"%&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\\n\\n      // 排除乱码文件名\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.limit);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.offset);\\n      }\\n\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\\n      \\n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\\n      const fileMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, FileRecord&amp;gt;();\\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\\n        if (row.file_hash) {\\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\\n          if (!existing || new Date(row.created_at) &amp;gt; new Date(existing.created_at)) {\\n            fileMap.set(row.file_hash, row);\\n          }\\n        } else {\\n          // 没有哈希值的文件，使用file_id作为key\\n          fileMap.set(row.file_id, row);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      return Array.from(fileMap.values());\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n      return [];\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新文件信息\\n   */\\n  async updateFile(fileId: string, updates: {\\n    description?: string;\\n    tags?: string[];\\n    category?: string;\\n    metadata?: any;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Request, Response } from 'express';\\nimport { techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechCategoryDTO, UpdateTechCategoryDTO } from '../types/database';\\n\\nexport class TechCategoryController {\\n  /**\\n   * 创建技术分类\\n   */\\n  async create(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const data: CreateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.create(data);\\n      res.status(201).json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category,\\n        message: '技术分类创建成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Create tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类详情\\n   */\\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(id);\\n      if (!category) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类列表\\n   */\\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const {\\n        page = 1,\\n        pageSize = 20,\\n        orderBy = 'sort_order',\\n        orderDirection = 'ASC',\\n        status,\\n        parent_id\\n      } = req.query;\\n\\n      const options = {\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\\n        where: {} as any\\n      };\\n\\n      if (status) {\\n        options.where.status = status;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\\n      }\\n\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.findAll(options);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: result\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech categories error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类列表失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const tree = await techCategoryModel.getTree();\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: tree\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech category tree error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类树失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术分类\\n   */\\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.update(id, data);\\n      \\n      if (!category) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category,\\n        message: '技术分类更新成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Update tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类\\n   */\\n  async delete(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const success = await techCategoryModel.delete(id);\\n      if (!success) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        message: '技术分类删除成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Delete tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\n   */\\n  async search(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const { keyword, page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = req.query;\\n      \\n      if (!keyword) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '搜索关键词不能为空'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const options = {\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string)\\n      };\\n\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.search(keyword as string, options);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: result\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Search tech categories error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '搜索技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 批量更新排序\\n   */\\n  async updateSortOrder(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const { items } = req.body;\\n      \\n      if (!Array.isArray(items)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的排序数据'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      await techCategoryModel.updateSortOrder(items);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        message: '排序更新成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Update sort order error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '更新排序失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\\nimport { \\n  TechPoint, \\n  CreateTechPointDTO, \\n  UpdateTechPointDTO, \\n  QueryOptions, \\n  PaginatedResult,\\n  Status,\\n  TechType,\\n  Priority\\n} from '../types/database';\\n\\nexport class TechPointModel {\\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\\n\\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\\n    this.db = db;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建技术点\\n   */\\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \\n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \\n        keywords, source_url, created_by\\n      )\\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = [\\n      data.name,\\n      data.description || null,\\n      data.category_id || null,\\n      data.parent_id || null,\\n      data.level || 1,\\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\\n      data.source_url || null,\\n      data.created_by || null\\n    ];\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\\n   */\\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有技术点\\n   */\\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\\n\\n    // 添加WHERE条件\\n    if (options.where) {\\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n        conditions.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n        values.push(value);\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (conditions.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 添加排序\\n    if (options.orderBy) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&amp;#96;;\\n    } else {\\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取总数\\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\\n\\n    // 添加分页\\n    if (options.limit) {\\n      sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&amp;#96;;\\n      if (options.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\\n    \\n    return {\\n      data,\\n      total,\\n      page,\\n      pageSize,\\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据分类ID获取技术点\\n   */\\n  async findByCategoryId(categoryId: number, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE category_id = ? AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [categoryId, Status.ACTIVE]);\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据父级ID获取子技术点\\n   */\\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const whereCondition = parentId === null ? 'parent_id IS NULL' : 'parent_id = ?';\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE ${whereCondition} AND status = ?\\n      ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const values = parentId === null ? [Status.ACTIVE] : [parentId, Status.ACTIVE];\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术点树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE status = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\\n\\n    if (categoryId) {\\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\\n      values.push(categoryId);\\n    }\\n\\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&amp;gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\\n    \\n    // 构建树结构\\n    const techPointMap = new Map&amp;lt;number, TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&amp;gt;();\\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp;amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\\n\\n    // 初始化所有技术点\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 构建父子关系\\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&amp;gt; {\\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\\n      \\n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n      } else {\\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\\n        if (parent) {\\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return rootTechPoints;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术点\\n   */\\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&amp;lt;TechPoint | null&amp;gt; {\\n    const fields: string[] = [];\\n    const values: any[] = [];\\n\\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (value !== undefined) {\\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\\n          fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\\n        } else {\\n          fields.push(&amp;#96;${key} = ?&amp;#96;);\\n          values.push(value);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\\n      return this.findById(id);\\n    }\\n\\n    values.push(id);\\n    \\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n      RETURNING *\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\\n    return result.length &amp;gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    // 检查是否有关联的车型\\n    const carModelsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_point_car_models WHERE tech_point_id = ?';\\n    const carModelsResult = await this.db.query(carModelsSql, [id]);\\n    if (carModelsResult[0].count &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with associated car models');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = &amp;#96;\\n      UPDATE tech_points \\n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n      WHERE id = ?\\n    &amp;#96;;\\n    \\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ARCHIVED, id]);\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 物理删除技术点\\n   */\\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\\n    if (children.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\\n    }\\n\\n    const sql = 'DELETE FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &amp;gt; 0 : result.changes &amp;gt; 0;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术点\\n   */\\n  async search(keyword: string, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&amp;lt;PaginatedResult&amp;lt;TechPoint&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    let sql = &amp;#96;\\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \\n      WHERE (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR keywords LIKE ?)         "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst checkHistoryRecords = async \n\n      setShowHistoryView(false);\n    } finally {\n      setCheckingHistory(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 加载历史记录（用于模态框）\n  const loadHistoryRecords = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    setHistoryLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 1000\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\n          let category: string | undefined;\n          if (source.metadata) {\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\n              try {\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\n              } catch (e) {\n                // 忽略解析错误\n              }\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\n            }\n          }\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\n          if (source.category) {\n            category = source.category;\n          }\n          return category &amp;&amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\n        });\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载历史记录失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setHistoryLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n        if (!options?.append) {\n          try {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\n              success: sourceResult.success,\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n              error: sourceResult.error\n            });\n            \n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data ? sourceResult.data : [];\n            const conversationSources = detail.sources || [];\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 对话来源 + 数据库来源\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加对话中的来源\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，至少保留对话中的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n         "contents": "// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/page-type/:pageType', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { pageType } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByPageType(pageType);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取页面类型来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取页面类型来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据source_id获取来源信息（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/AI问答-技术包装2.yml",

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 291
          }
        },
        "contents": "            **信息输入源**:\n\n            - 用户原始问题：{{#sys.query#}}\n\n            - 内部知识库信息：{{#1758900784102.Additional_information#}}\n\n            - 技术转译内容：{{#1758946605171.text#}}\n\n\n            **信息源标注规范**:\n\n            - 📚 **[内部知识库]** - 来自企业内部权威技术文档\n\n            - 🔬 **[专业知识库]** - 来自外部专业技术资源\n\n            - 💡 **[技术转译]** - 通俗化解释，辅助理解\n\n            - 🔄 **[综合分析]** - 基于多源信息的整合判断\n\n            - ⚠️ **[信息缺失]** - 知识库中暂无相关信息\n\n            - 🔍 **[推理分析]** - 基于已有信息的合理推测\n\n\n            **问题类型识别与适配策略**:\n\n\n            ### A类：完整技术产品分析（适用完整六模块）\n\n            **识别特征**: 询问具体技术产品、系统、解决方案的全面信息\n\n            **示例问题**: \"分析XX技术\"、\"XX产品技术解析\"、\"XX系统架构分析\"\n\n            **输出策略**: 使用完整六模块框架，全面覆盖技术信息\n\n\n            ### B类：技术原理/概念解释（重点模块：概述+技术架构+总结）\n\n            **识别特征**: 询问技术原理、工作机制、核心概念\n\n            **示例问题**: \"XX技术原理是什么\"、\"XX是如何工作的\"、\"解释XX概念\"\n\n            **输出策略**: 强化概述和技术架构模块，简化其他模块\n\n\n            ### C类：性能对比分析（重点模块：核心创新+测试认证）\n\n            **识别特征**: 询问技术优势、性能对比、竞争分析\n\n            **示例问题**: \"XX技术有什么优势\"、\"XX vs XX对比\"、\"XX性能怎么样\"\n\n            **输出策略**: 突出创新点和测试数据，强化对比分析\n\n\n            ### D类：应用场景咨询（重点模块：应用效果+总结）\n\n            **识别特征**: 询问应用场景、实际效果、市场表现\n\n            **示例问题**: \"XX技术应用在哪里\"、\"XX有什么用途\"、\"XX市场效果如何\"",
